title: She Got Life for Murder. The 'Blood' Was Sound-Deadener.

narration: A mother was jailed for life for murdering her baby.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (warm grade); judge: gavel -> sit; lindy [court]: hands_together -> distraught -> hand_to_face; camera push/pull; overlays: label 'NT SUPREME COURT · 1982'.

sources.claim_text: On 29 October 1982 Lindy was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment with hard labour.

narration: But the 'baby's blood' in her car was never blood.
shots.visual_description: lab (cold grade); scientist: examine -> realise; camera push/pull; overlays: callout 'NOT BLOOD'.

sources.claim_text: The 'spray' under the dashboard was a sound-deadening compound applied by the manufacturer; the inquiry found no blood in the car.

narration: August 1980. A campsite at Uluru.

sources.claim_text: Azaria disappeared on 17 August 1980 from the family's tent at the Uluru (Ayers Rock) campsite, Northern Territory.

narration: Lindy Chamberlain said a dingo took her nine week old daughter, Azaria, from their tent.
shots.visual_description: camp night (night grade); lindy: torch -> torch_low -> torch (walks); michael [camp]: torch (walks); camera push/pull, handheld; overlays: label 'LINDY CHAMBERLAIN'.

sources.claim_text: Lindy Chamberlain said a dingo had taken nine-week-old Azaria from the tent.

narration: Azaria was never found. Her jumpsuit was, near the rock.
But not the matinee jacket Lindy said Azaria wore over it.
shots.visual_description: task force (cold grade); detective: arms_crossed -> point_up -> stand -> hand_to_face; camera push/pull; overlays: label 'AUGUST 1980'.

sources.claim_text: Azaria's body was never found; her jumpsuit was found near the base of the rock about a week later.
The matinee jacket Lindy said Azaria wore over the jumpsuit was not found with it.

narration: Prosecutors said she killed Azaria in the family car,
and that tests found a baby's blood. Even a spray of it, under the dashboard.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (warm grade); judge: sit; barrister: stand -> present -> point; keyed camera moves.

sources.claim_text: The prosecution case was that Lindy killed Azaria in the family car.
Forensic evidence at trial alleged infant (foetal) blood in the car, including a 'spray' under the dashboard.

narration: October 1982: guilty of murder. Life, with hard labour.
In 1984, the High Court rejected her appeal, three votes to two.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (warm grade); judge: sit -> gavel -> sit; lindy [court]: hands_together -> shocked -> distraught -> hand_to_face; keyed camera moves; overlays: card 'NT SUPREME COURT · 29 OCT 1982 / GUILTY OF MURDER / LIFE, WITH HARD LABOUR', label 'HIGH COURT OF AUSTRALIA · 1984', vote.

overlays.text: NT SUPREME COURT · 29 OCT 1982 / GUILTY OF MURDER / LIFE, WITH HARD LABOUR

sources.claim_text: On 29 October 1982 Lindy was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment with hard labour.
Michael Chamberlain was convicted as an accessory after the fact (18-month suspended sentence).
The High Court dismissed the appeal 3-2 on 22 February 1984 (Chamberlain v R (No 2) [1984] HCA 7).

narration: Then, in early 1986, a tourist fell to his death from Uluru.
Searching near dingo dens below the rock, police found something else.
shots.visual_description: rock night (night grade); searcher_b: torch (walks); searcher: torch_low (walks); searcher_b: torch_low -> realise (walks); searcher: torch -> kneel (walks); keyed camera moves, handheld; overlays: label 'EARLY 1986'.

sources.claim_text: In early 1986 a British tourist fell to his death from Uluru; searchers looked for his remains below the rock, in an area of dingo lairs. (Exact date of the fall varies by source; not named on screen.)
Azaria's matinee jacket was found on 2 February 1986, partly buried near a dingo lair, during that search.

narration: Azaria's matinee jacket.
shots.visual_description: sand close (none grade); camera push/pull; overlays: label '2 FEBRUARY 1986'.

sources.claim_text: Azaria's matinee jacket was found on 2 February 1986, partly buried near a dingo lair, during that search.

narration: Five days later, Lindy was released from prison.
shots.visual_description: gate dawn (dawn grade); lindy [release]: stand -> relieved (walks); camera push/pull; overlays: label '7 FEBRUARY 1986'.

sources.claim_text: Lindy was released on 7 February 1986 (sentence remitted; not a pardon), five days after the jacket was found.

narration: Then a Royal Commission re-examined the science.
The 'blood spray' under the dashboard? Sound-deadening compound, applied at the factory.
No blood was found in the car at all.
shots.visual_description: lab (cold grade); scientist: examine -> realise -> determined -> stand; keyed camera moves; overlays: label 'ROYAL COMMISSION · 1986-87', callout 'THE 'BLOOD SPRAY'', callout 'SOUND-DEADENING COMPOUND', card 'BLOOD FOUND IN THE CAR: / NONE'.

overlays.text: BLOOD FOUND IN THE CAR: / NONE

sources.claim_text: A Royal Commission (Justice Trevor Morling) re-examined the evidence; its 1987 report found serious doubts about the convictions.
The 'spray' under the dashboard was a sound-deadening compound applied by the manufacturer; the inquiry found no blood in the car.

narration: In 1988, all the convictions were quashed.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (warm grade); judge: sit_read; michael: stand_tense -> stand; lindy [release]: hands_together -> relieved -> hand_to_face; camera push/pull; overlays: label '15 SEPTEMBER 1988', stamp 'QUASHED'.

sources.claim_text: On 15 September 1988 the NT Court of Criminal Appeal quashed all convictions of Lindy and Michael Chamberlain.

narration: But only in 2012 did a coroner finally rule how Azaria died:
attacked and taken by a dingo.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (cold grade); official: sit_read -> sit; camera push/pull; overlays: label '2012 · FOURTH INQUEST', card 'CORONER'S FINDING · 12 JUNE 2012 / CAUSE OF DEATH: / 'ATTACKED AND TAKEN / BY A DINGO''.

overlays.text: CORONER'S FINDING · 12 JUNE 2012 / CAUSE OF DEATH: / 'ATTACKED AND TAKEN / BY A DINGO'

sources.claim_text: On 12 June 2012, at the fourth inquest, NT Coroner Elizabeth Morris found Azaria's death was caused by being 'attacked and taken by a dingo'.

narration: Just as her mother said, almost thirty-two years earlier.
shots.visual_description: rock dawn (dawn grade); camera push/pull; overlays: label '17 AUG 1980 - 12 JUN 2012', svg.

sources.claim_text: On 12 June 2012, at the fourth inquest, NT Coroner Elizabeth Morris found Azaria's death was caused by being 'attacked and taken by a dingo'.
